description: This file defines a class UserMenuConfigurator which implements a menu configuration for the 'orangehrmAdminPlugin' in the OrangeHRM system. The class sets up menu behavior related to system user views within the administrative module.

classes.name: UserMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for user-related administrative screens in OrangeHRM plugin.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewSystemUsers' in the admin module and returns null.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Method implementing the MenuConfigurator interface to configure the menu for a given screen.
